question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to **“damaged”**.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Flawless**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"damaged"** refers to something that has been harmed or impaired, reducing its value or usefulness. (क्षतिग्रस्त)

 
 
• **Example:** The car was damaged in the accident and needed extensive repairs.
 

 
• **"Flawless"** means something that is perfect, without any imperfections, defects, or damage. (बिना दोष के)

 
 
• **Example:** Her performance in the competition was flawless, earning her a perfect score.
